shell_commands: git status && git branch --show-current && git log -n 5 --oneline
node -e "const pkg = require('ajv/package.json'); console.log(pkg.name, pkg.version, pkg.types)" && grep -n '"node_modules/ajv"' package-lock.json -A 15
node -e "const pkg = require('ajv/package.json'); console.log(pkg)" && ls -la node_modules/ajv/lib/
find node_modules -maxdepth 3 -name "package.json" -exec grep -l '"ajv"' {} + | xargs -I{} sh -c 'echo "=== {} ==="; grep -C 2 "ajv" {}'
npm install --save ajv@^8 --ignore-scripts --silent && node -e "const pkg = require('ajv/package.json'); console.log(pkg.name, pkg.version)"
node --input-type=module -e "import {Ajv, ErrorObject} from 'ajv'; const ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false, allErrors: true}); console.log(typeof ajv.compile);"
node --input-type=module -e "import {Ajv} from 'ajv'; const ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false, allErrors: true}); console.log(typeof ajv.compile);"

node --input-type=module -e "import {Ajv} from 'ajv'; const ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false, allErrors: true}); const validate = ajv.compile({type: 'object', properties: {location: {type: 'string'}, units: {type: 'string', enum: ['celsius', 'fahrenheit']}}, required: ['location']}); validate({units: 'celsius'}); console.log(JSON.stringify(validate.errors, null, 2));"

npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md CHANGELOG.md .lore/dod.md package.json && node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs && node scripts/check-spec-links.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md

git status -s && git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): add ajv dependency and validate required inputSchema fields" && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit && git status
